locations.name: Anand Vihar ISBT & Surajmal Vihar Road

borderDetails.explanation: This side of Road 56 lies inside the Delhi boundary pillar, routing all civic complaints to Delhi authorities rather than Uttar Pradesh.

fallen_tree.responsible_authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) — Horticulture Department (Shahdara South Zone)

portal.name: MCD 311 Citizen App / MCD Online Portal

fallen_tree.reason: Because this stretch lies on the Delhi side of the Ghazipur drain border, roadside tree clearance is legally assigned to MCD Shahdara South.

damaged_road.responsible_authority: Public Works Department (PWD) Delhi — Road Division (East)
damaged_road.reason: Road No. 56 is an inter-state arterial corridor wider than 60 feet, placing asphalt maintenance under Delhi PWD rather than the municipal ward.

overflowing_garbage.responsible_authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) — Department of Environment & Sanitation
overflowing_garbage.reason: Primary waste clearance and collection depots on the Anand Vihar approach are serviced by the MCD Shahdara South sanitation contractor.

broken_traffic_signal.responsible_authority: Delhi Traffic Police — Traffic Engineering & Signal Cell

portal.name: Delhi Traffic Police Grievance Portal & Sentinel

broken_traffic_signal.reason: Traffic control lights at the Anand Vihar ISBT junction are operated directly by the Delhi Traffic Police signals unit.

locations.name: Apsara Border & GT Road West Approach

borderDetails.explanation: Points west of the Delhi border police booth fall under the jurisdiction of Shahdara North MCD and Delhi PWD.

fallen_tree.responsible_authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) — Horticulture Division (Shahdara North)
fallen_tree.reason: Roadside tree canopies along the western approach to Apsara Border are maintained by MCD Shahdara North.

damaged_road.responsible_authority: Public Works Department (PWD) Delhi — Division M-31

portal.name: PWD Delhi Sewa Grievance Portal
portal.field_hint: Select 'Grand Trunk Road West Approach (NH-1 Alternate)'

damaged_road.reason: The Grand Trunk Road approach up to the border toll pillar is classified as an arterial highway managed by Delhi PWD.

overflowing_garbage.responsible_authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) — Sanitation Wing (Shahdara North)
overflowing_garbage.reason: Street sweeping and waste transfer on the Delhi side of the GT Road border are governed by MCD Shahdara North sanitation ward.

broken_traffic_signal.responsible_authority: Delhi Traffic Police — Northern Range Signals Division
broken_traffic_signal.reason: Signal hardware at the Apsara Border rotary is owned and serviced by the Delhi Police traffic signals contractor.

locations.name: Connaught Place Radial Roads & Barakhamba
locations.zone: New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC Special Jurisdiction)

fallen_tree.responsible_authority: New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) — Horticulture Department
fallen_tree.reason: Connaught Place and adjoining radial avenues fall under the exclusive municipal charter of NDMC rather than MCD.

damaged_road.responsible_authority: New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) — Civil Engineering Department
damaged_road.reason: All inner, middle, and radial roads in CP are maintained directly by NDMC civil engineering division.

overflowing_garbage.responsible_authority: New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) — Public Health Department
overflowing_garbage.reason: Commercial bin collection and automated sweeping in Connaught Place are executed round-the-clock by NDMC sanitation teams.

broken_traffic_signal.responsible_authority: Delhi Traffic Police in coordination with NDMC Electrical Wing
broken_traffic_signal.reason: Radial road signals are timed by Delhi Traffic Police with electrical grid power supplied through NDMC.

locations.name: Lajpat Nagar Central Market & Feroze Gandhi Marg

fallen_tree.responsible_authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) — Horticulture (South Zone)
fallen_tree.reason: Avenue trees along Lajpat Nagar internal market roads fall under the administrative jurisdiction of MCD South Zone.

damaged_road.responsible_authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) — Works Department (South Zone)
damaged_road.reason: Feroze Gandhi Marg is an internal commercial road under 60 feet wide, placing resurfacing under MCD rather than Delhi PWD.

overflowing_garbage.responsible_authority: Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) — Department of Environment & Sanitation
overflowing_garbage.reason: Market association waste disposal points and secondary dustbins are serviced daily by MCD South sanitation trucks.

broken_traffic_signal.responsible_authority: Delhi Traffic Police — Southern District Traffic Unit

portal.name: Delhi Traffic Police Online Grievance
portal.field_hint: Select 'Signal Defect' > 'Ring Road Lajpat Nagar Cut'

broken_traffic_signal.reason: Signal junction synchronization at the market ring road entry is controlled by Delhi Traffic Police Southern Unit.
